finding.evidence: no privacy policy, no information on the data collected by the checkout form
finding.description: Personal data is collected without the information the law requires.

recommendation.goal: What is the recommended fix for this web security flaw: missing-privacy-policy (Personal data is collected without the information the law requires. Evidence: no privacy policy, no information on the data collected by the checkout form). State the concrete fix and cite a primary source (OWASP, MDN, NIST, PCI DSS, IETF RFC, or the vendor's own advisory).
recommendation.answer: Recommended fix: Publish a clear, easily accessible privacy policy and provide information at the point of collection on the checkout form. Concretely: add a footer link to the privacy policy plus a just-in-time notice at the checkout explaining what personal data is collected (e.g. name, address, payment details), for what purposes and legal basis, retention, third-party sharing, user rights and contact details, and obtain consent where required before collecting/submitting the data. This implements OWASP User Privacy Protection guidance to be transparent about collection and use of user data and to meet privacy obligations for personal data.

sources.contribution: Web developers should provide transparency about what user data is collected and how it is used

verification.claim: Web developers should provide transparency about what user data is collected and how it is used
verification.detail: nearest passages: « Honesty & Transparency ¶ If the web application cannot provide enough legal or political protections to the user, or if the web application cannot prevent misuse or disclosure of sensitive information such as logs,  » « Digital Certificate Pinning ¶ Certificate Pinning is the practice of hardcoding or storing a predefined set of information (usually hashes) for digital certificates/public keys in the user agent (be it web browser,  » « Many web applications need user content to operate, and this is completely acceptable as a business process; however web developers are advised to consider giving users the option of blocking external content as a precau »

fix.summary: Add privacy policy to legal notice and just-in-time notice with link on checkout without blocking submission.
fix.risk: Static informational HTML only; checkout still accepts posts without consent so no journey breaks.

applied.find: if (path === '/mentions-legales') return html(page('mentions.html')); // FLAW 15 (compliance): no privacy policy, no cookie notice, personal data collected without information
applied.replace:
if (path === '/mentions-legales') return html(page('mentions.html') + `

Politique de confidentialité

Données collectées au moment de la commande : nom, adresse e-mail, adresse postale et informations de paiement (carte masquée).

Finalités et base légale : traitement de la commande et livraison (exécution du contrat), facturation (obligation légale).

Conservation : 3 ans pour les commandes, puis archivage légal.

Partage : aucun tiers sauf prestataires de livraison et de paiement.

Vos droits : accès, rectification, effacement, opposition et portabilité. Contact : privacy@example.org.

Politique de confidentialité

`);

return html(page('checkout.html') + `

Données collectées : nom, e-mail, adresse et carte bancaire pour traiter votre commande (exécution du contrat). Conservation 3 ans. Vos droits : accès, rectification, effacement via privacy@example.org. Politique de confidentialité

`);
